machine: i7-12700 (20 threads), 30 GB, SU2 8.3.0, Open MPI 5.0.11, gmsh 4.15.2; the Euler runs of 2026-10-07 (ignisyeet commit 8d60708) shared the machine with another 8-rank SU2 job (load average about 12)

settings.note: z_mirror_mesh makes -alpha the exact mirror image of +alpha, so mirror mode needs no -alpha solves; on an asymmetric half-model mesh mirror mode solves every alpha > 0 also at -alpha

M2.0.extrapolation: none (increments 0.0004 and 0.0007 on the finest meshes)

farfield_sensitivity: farfield_sensitivity.csv (fins at 2 mm, commit e00ed02): M0.8 alpha 4, CN within 0.25 % for 10, 20, 40 body lengths
asymmetry: asymmetry_study.csv (fins at wall_size 10 mm, commit e00ed02); asymmetry_cause.csv; fin_resolution.csv

memory.model: eq-cfd-mem: 40 MB per rank + 3.3 kB per cell, from 4 x the largest-rank peak (4.8 GB at 1416k cells against 4 x 1149600 kB = 4.6 GB)
